channel.title: Kata Shell Changelog
channel.description: Most recent changes to Kata Shell, with links to downloads.

item.title: Kata Shell 0.9.3
item.description:
- License tool adjustment
- Full Disk Access
- License Cross-Verification Tests
- Ribbon Overflow Chevron
- Tree Selection Invariant
- Zoom Refactoring
- Context Menu Items Order
- Content view header auto-fit
- Editor Content Guards
- Activation core
- User associations
- Fix Address Bar Cancel Edit
- Terminal - Fix and Improve
- Update Documentation
- Add a confirmation on object move
- Preview Mode Splitter
- Proper Local Build and Debug Signing
- Make Object Rename In-place and File-related Buttons context
- Add F8 Key for Content object delete
- Documentation of Planning session
- Mountable Volumes
- Fix Mounted Resources and /Volumes Collision
- Fix Editor Tab Switch Stale Content
- Permission handling verification
- Anchor tab invariant
- Viewer/Editor F3/F4 exit semantics
- Unsaved changes on quit and window close
- Tree Actualization
- Volumes Deduplication
- Fix: Closing a terminal tab does not terminate its shell
- Fix: Network Volumes Performance
- Fix: Favorites Path Sync
- Deactivate the navigation in the context of document editing
- Add Statistics
- Show License Info at Status bar right zone
- Add a Custom About Window
- Three-Tier Licensing
- Improved License processing UX

item.title: Kata Shell 0.9.1
item.description: - Added automatic updates: Kata Shell now checks for new versions and updates itself (Sparkle 2).
